translations.web: “I, Yahweh, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”
translations.bsb: I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
translations.kjv: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
translations.asv: I, Jehovah, search the mind, I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.
